note: Protracted standoff -> long duration, narrowing path.

article.headline: Pentagon official says Gulf military standoff with Iran could drag on for many months

assignments.reason: A Pentagon official explicitly forecasts the standoff dragging on for many months, pointing to a long conflict duration.
An expectation of a months-long military standoff implies diplomacy is not delivering a near-term off-ramp, narrowing the resolution path.

recorded_response.overall_rationale: The headline frames an enduring military confrontation with Iran lasting many months, signalling a long conflict and a diminishing near-term diplomatic exit without yet indicating outright closure of the strait.
